content: Two hybrid recsys patterns: cascade (fast candidate generation stage -> expensive rerank stage) and weighted scoring (FinalScore = w1*CFScore + w2*ContentScore + w3*PopularityScore/FactorScore). For financial assets, treat content/factor, collaborative, and contextual (user profile) signals as distinct scored inputs combined via weighted sum, with cold-start handled via content/factor scoring alone until enough interaction data exists.
